record_title: Full initial weight gaps force divisibility in binary linear codes
provenance: A global structural consequence of the minimal-vector ceiling and binary disjoint-support decomposition of Ashikhmin--Barg, motivated by the local mirror-vanishing theorem of He, arXiv:2609.20344v1.
limitations: The initial gap must extend through n-k+1, which is stronger than the short-gap hypothesis in the motivating preprint. The recursive disjoint-support argument is binary-specific. No full classification is given for even minimum distance. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual folklore and near-simultaneous priority risk.
